 Cyclonic storm “Akvan” moves closer to coastal states of Andhra, Tamil Nadu and Odisha 
 The Cyclonic Storm “Akvan” prevailing over central parts of South and adjoining Westcentral Bay of Bengal has moved slowly northwards at a slow pace of three kilometer per hour during the past 6 hours and lay centred during the day over the same region. The cyclone has moved closer to the coastal states of Tamil Nadu, Andhra and Odisha.  
 The cyclone is likely to move northwestwards and intensify further into a very severe cyclonic storm around 19th November morning and continue  moving northwestward.  Akvan will then turn into a severe cyclonic storm and  cross Andhra Pradesh & Yanam coasts between Nellore and Visakhapatnam, around noon of 20th with wind speed gusting upto 145 kmph. According to the weather department,  moderate to heavy rains are likely over  isolated places in Northern Tamil Nadu in the coming days.
